recreation_brief:
1. Set the slide background to solid light gray #F2F2F2.
2. Place the title centered at the top (~5-10% of slide height): 'Classification – Two Dimensional Case' in large bold sans-serif, with 'Classification –' in red #C00000 and 'Two Dimensional Case' in dark blue #0000CC.
3. Place a circle at the top-right corner with #FFFF99 yellow fill and black #000000 outline, containing the black slide number '12'.
4. Draw the main frame: a rectangle with red outline spanning ~8-95% of slide width and ~18-95% of slide height; it holds all remaining content.
5. Inside the frame along the left edge, draw a red #C00000 vertical arrow pointing up and label it 'Weight' with the label text rotated 90°.
6. Inside the frame along the bottom edge, draw a red #C00000 horizontal arrow pointing right and label it 'Length'.
7. In the left-center of the frame (~10-65% width), draw a tilted light-blue #DCE6F1 parallelogram representing the 3D decision plane.
8. On the parallelogram, place ~10 black open circles clustered in the upper-left area and add the text label 'Steel' at the top-left of the plane.
9. On the parallelogram, place ~12 brown #B08D57 open circles clustered in the lower-right area and add the text label 'Wood' at the right-middle of the plane.
10. Place exactly 3 red-circled '?' marks at these positions: one near top-center on the plane, one mid-right, one lower-left.
11. Place a small black arrow/cursor shape near the center of the plane.
12. On the right side of the frame (~60-90% width, ~20-28% height), add the bold blue #0000CC heading 'Length and Weight of different samples of Steel and wood Bars'.
13. Directly below the heading (~60-90% width, ~30-40% height), add a two-entry legend: an open black circle labeled 'Steel' and an open brown #B08D57 circle labeled 'Wood'.
14. At right-middle (~70-88% width, ~42-52% height), add a white #FFFFFF box with a thin gray border containing three lines: 'Model' in red #FF0000, 'I/P: Length, Weight' in black bold, 'O/P: Class Type' in black bold.
15. At bottom-right (~62-90% width, ~55-88% height), add a pale-yellow #FFFFCC box with a green #00B050 border containing seven lines: 'Model ( Plane )' with 'Model' in red italics and '( Plane )' in green; 'z = a x + b y + c' in blue #0000FF; 'Class = a * Length + b * Weight + c' in blue with 'Class' in red; 'Class > 0  Steel' in blue with red symbols; 'Class < 0  Wood' in blue with red symbols; 'Class = 0  Undefined' in blue with red symbols; 'Model Parameters : a , b , c' in blue italics with 'a', 'b', 'c' in red.
